hook: Her Gravestone Never Mentions Her Books
text: On a July morning in eighteen seventeen, Jane Austen was buried in Winchester Cathedral. She was forty-one. Her sister Cassandra watched from a window as the little procession turned the corner and passed out of sight. The gravestone praises her kind heart, her sweet temper and her remarkable mind. But it does not say that she wrote novels. Not one word. Her name had never appeared on any of her books. Only after she was gone did her brother tell the world who the Lady really was.
